_comment: Generated by scripts/gen_3d_models.py. Maps every repo-local VRML model to the dimensions it was built from.  Standard parts use the real KiCad library (see LIBRARY_MODELS in the generator).  Regenerate with --check in CI.

ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U.source: X/Y: F.Fab body drawing of RF_Module:ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U as committed (18.100 x 19.300 mm).  The Espressif module is 18.0 x 25.5 mm, so the committed land is shallower than the real module - recorded, not hidden.  The installed library has ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 and -2 but NOT -1U, so a repo-local model is kept.
todo_unverified: the 18.0 x 25.5 mm Espressif module outline vs the 18.100 x 19.300 mm committed footprint drawing - unreconciled
Z 3.10 mm - ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U module height is not stated in any in-repo record
ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U.unit_convention: 1 VRML unit = 2.54 mm (all coords divided by 2.54)

SolarCell_LARGE_78.55x38.90.source: X/Y/Z: 78.55 x 38.90 x 0.21 mm - ADR-049 s'Measured inputs' (cited by ADR-051 s1.4): 'the LARGE cell as 78.55 x 38.90 x 0.21 mm, 30.6 cm2, ~0.5 V, ~1.2 A'.  The face is drawn deliberately DARK BLUE (diffuseColor 0.09 0.10 0.42) so a cell can never be read as copper or silkscreen.  The frame is light grey (0.55 0.56 0.60).  Two-material IndexedFaceSet ported from scripts/gen_3d_models_wing.py.
SolarCell_LARGE_78.55x38.90.unit_convention: 1 VRML unit = 2.54 mm (all coords divided by 2.54)
